content:
**Big Maw** is a location in The Mire region of Appalachia.

This natural feature of The Mire seems to have been used by cultists for their strange, unspeakable rituals. It is the home of the local legend Ryl-Tkannoth, Maw-Begotten.

Big Maw is a giant hole in the ground with a small pond at the bottom. There are stairs leading to the surface of the pond. At the bottom of the pond, there are two cultist statues overlooking a sacrificial altar.

Another Spring - Note, on a picnic table.

Big Maw appears in *Fallout 76*.

An altar located at the bottom of Big Maw
